## Goal
ROADMAP 3.2 says a score is always shown with its coverage. `coverage_of` (`src/freemyid/exposure_models.py:81-92`) gives one total, so "12 of 40 sites checked" can hide that none of the people-search sites (the ones that matter most, `src/freemyid/engine/exposure_score.py:44-52`) were read.

## Order
Start only after WO-242 is merged (it also edits `exposure_models.py`).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A new pure helper `coverage_by_category(entries) -> dict[BrokerCategory | None, Coverage]` in `exposure_models.py`; per category the counts obey the same identity as `Coverage` (70-72), and the categories sum to `coverage_of(entries)`.
2. A new pure helper `coverage_gap_note(by_category) -> str | None` returning one plain sentence when no people-search or background-check site could be read automatically (for example "None of the people-search sites could be checked automatically, so please check them by hand."), else None. Never "safe", "guarantee" or "100%".
3. Additive only: `coverage_of`, `coverage_note` and every model keep their signatures and output; nothing calls the new helpers yet (in-house decides where to show them).
4. Tests build `ExposureEntry` lists directly (fake broker names), including entries with no category (older stored scans).

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
